## What's Changed
* Add wait_time.poisson() for Poisson-distributed task arrivals by @whr313703 in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3510
* Add rest method to HttpUser by @anandghegde in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3512
* Compute Med. with the same rank as the 50% percentile by @gyanu2507 in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3508
* [DX] Improve error message when Web UI assets are missing by @suraj-self in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3514
* chore: add typos linter by @even-even in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3511
* Don't let a spawning_complete from an unknown worker kill client_listener by @ergdevops in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3516

## New Contributors
* @whr313703 made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3510
* @anandghegde made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3512
* @gyanu2507 made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3508
* @suraj-self made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3514
* @ergdevops made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3516

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/locustio/locust/compare/2.46.5...2.46.6
